properties.answer: BUILD IT FIRST. Anthony, 2026-09-11: "go with your suggested order" — the recommended order being release binary → server-guaranteed export → version guard → deferred-decision status, with findability and description accuracy run together as one measurement-then-fix pass, and the sweep-findings requirement retired. The release-profile binary is first because it is a wrapper change with no design work behind it, it is the largest user-visible win measured (93x on a graph walk, 12.5s → 2.0s warm on the region report), and every other cost number in the sweep was measured on the debug binary and cannot be judged until this lands.

properties.question: You accepted that a session must run a release-profile binary, rebuilt deliberately rather than on every launch — measured at 93x on one walk — but nothing is yet allocated to change the launch wrapper. Build it in the next increment, hold it, or drop it?
